stemMd: The historians’ position is best characterized as

options.label: A
options.textMd: a qualified alternative explanation that broadens the factors considered.

options.label: B
options.textMd: a categorical denial that physical danger matters.

options.label: C
options.textMd: a claim that one institutional explanation covers every case.

options.label: D
options.textMd: an assertion based solely on the absence of records.

options.label: E
options.textMd: a demand that all quantitative history be abandoned.

explanationMd: They add a plausible, partly evidenced institutional mechanism while recognizing that it neither replaces hazards nor explains every voyage.

distractorRationale.d: Positive correspondence evidence also supports it.
distractorRationale.c: They acknowledge limits on its documented coverage.
distractorRationale.b: They explicitly preserve hazard as a factor.
